purpose: Classify whether the public X-HD author repository and adjacent public GitHub artifacts contain exact paper input datasets, hashes, dataset releases, LFS pointers, or download instructions sufficient to unblock full paper reproduction.

notes: README documents hd_exec arguments and says more options are in flags.cc.
README does not provide paper input archives, hashes, or dataset download instructions.

evidence: Paper-reproduction-apps/x-hd-paper/data/external/stanford contains public Stanford graphics archives and app-owned scaled PLY candidates used for Level-B graphics gates.
Paper-reproduction-apps/x-hd-paper/data/generated contains generated bounded/full-public WKT candidates used for Level-B geo gates.
Goal5214 and later provenance goals record /local/storage/shared/HDDatasets missing on the current POD.
No local author HDDatasets root, exact paper input hashes, or author-provided dataset bundle was found in the project evidence.

relationship_to_goals5318_5322.goal5318_water_bg: No author WKT files or hashes found; current ArcGIS public services remain Level-B.
relationship_to_goals5318_5322.goal5319_graphics: No author graphics input files, hashes, or preprocessing proof found; public Stanford assets remain Level-B.
relationship_to_goals5318_5322.goal5320_county_zcta: County source/conversion remains blocked; current ArcGIS/TIGER/RayJoin-CDB alternatives do not prove author WKT identity.
relationship_to_goals5318_5322.goal5321_osm: OSM remains snapshot/filter/conversion blocked; public SpatialHadoop catalog entries are not author files/hashes.
relationship_to_goals5318_5322.goal5322_brats: BraTS remains access/conversion blocked; official data are NIfTI volumes and author conversion provenance is missing.

blocking_gaps: No GitHub release or package contains author paper input datasets.
No .gitattributes file or LFS pointer manifest was found in the checked public repository.
No top-level data/HDDatasets/datasets directory exists in the checked public repository.
No recursive-tree input blobs with typical X-HD paper input extensions were found in the checked main branch.
The public repository contains source, scripts, and checked-in JSON logs, but not the exact input files or hashes needed for Level-C exact dataset reproduction.
Current local/POD Level-B assets do not establish byte identity with the author's /local/storage/shared/HDDatasets inputs.

level_c_exact_requires_one_of: author-provided converted point-set files or hashes
byte-identical regeneration from pinned public sources plus documented author conversion/export pipeline
external review accepting deterministic public-source reconstruction as exact-equivalent

pod_usage.reason: This goal is an external artifact availability and repository-provenance sweep. GPU/POD execution cannot create missing author input provenance.

recommended_next_actions.action: Send Goals5318-5323 as one exact-provenance blocker packet for strict review.
Seek external author HDDatasets files, hashes, archived exports, or converted point-set bundles.
If no exact artifacts can be obtained, ask review/owner to choose between stopping full-paper claims at Level-B or defining an explicitly bounded public-reconstruction claim.
Use POD only after a concrete new input/provenance artifact appears and needs author hd_exec or RTDL verification.

allowed_summary: The public X-HD author repository currently provides source code, scripts, and checked-in logs, but no releases, LFS manifest, dataset directory, input blobs, author input hashes, or HDDatasets bundle. This strengthens the exact-input blocker: current evidence supports Level-B public/source-matched work, not full paper dataset reproduction.
not_allowed: claiming the public GitHub repository contains exact paper input datasets
claiming GitHub releases or LFS provide the missing datasets
claiming checked-in author logs are exact input files
promoting current Level-B public Stanford, ArcGIS, SpatialHadoop, or BraTS source references to exact paper inputs
claiming author-vs-RTDL performance ratio from this provenance sweep
